text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way back home from my outing
with Air
Groove, the walk signal up
ahead starts flashing.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hm. I guess we should wait.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Gah, almost there! Just one last push!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That voice...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, Taiki Shuttle comes blazing
past and
crosses the road in a flash.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Woohoo, by the skin of my teeth!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: That was peanuts, hehe.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Taiki! Hold it right there!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Gyah! Where'd you come from, Air
Groove?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: A blinking walk signal means don't walk! It's dangerous to rush across like that!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You need to be more aware of your
surroundings!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You're in the academy uniform—that
means
you're an ambassador for our
school.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You're not just representing yourself.
Everything
you say or do reflects on all
the Umamusume at
our academy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Okey-dokey... I get it... Sorry.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As long as you understand, I won't
lecture you
any further.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If I catch you doing that again, however, I will be asking you to write an essay reflecting on what you did. Are we clear?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: As clear as day, ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having avoided a more serious scolding,
Taiki
Shuttle dashes off into the
distance.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I hope she takes what I said to heart.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I hope she takes what I said to heart.

text_block_list.text:
Of course. Umamusume have physical
capabilities
vastly superior to those of
humans.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What may just be a little bump for us
could
seriously injure someone.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We must be constantly vigilant of our
bearings in
order to prevent any
unnecessary accidents.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I would hate to stir up ill will between

Umamusume and humans, after all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove nods to herself as she
speaks—her
words are resolute.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What, you too?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, then that badge of yours is
nothing but a
meaningless trinket!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You're meant to set a good example for
the
students at the academy! Gah, let's
just go!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You'd better prepare yourself for an
earful once
we get back. You have to
take your role as a
trainer more
seriously!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
True to her word, Air Groove delivers a
painfully
long lecture upon our arrival.
